# Retained Federal Register topics response

`federal-register-topics-2026-08-03.json` is the exact retained response from
`https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/topics.json`, copied from RefSpec's
fixture of the same name. No source bytes were changed.

- Bytes: 920,705
- SHA-256: `aba80a4dcacbffc7c9ec29eb88ea385ec313510fc8331d0f69078d940d1da35b`
- Rows: 1,044 `thesaurus`, 6,723 `ad_hoc`

The API gives no stable cross-capture topic identifier. Duplicate slugs and
three empty ad hoc slugs remain literal source data.
